test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Adipose
solution:
The correct answer is '***Stringy'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of** Adipose** is **(especially for body tissue) used for the storage of fat.**
 
• The meaning of **Stringy** is 
 **tall, wiry, and thin.**
 
 
• 
 The above two words are exactly opposite to each other.
 
 
• 
 Hence the correct Antonym for the word '**Adipose'**is '**Stringy'. **
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The meaning of other given words:

 

 
• **Glutinous: **Glue in texture**; sticky.**

 
• **Fat: **Having **a large amount of excess ****flesh.**

 
• **Tissue: Distinct types of material of which animals or plants are made, consisting of specialized cells and their products.**
